title: From evidence to decisions
summary: An example operating review combines available delivery, product and business evidence into a decision and action brief. The user selects the scope; missing evidence remains an explicit gap.

nodes.label: Delivery
nodes.description: Changes, tests, releases and known defects from the project.

nodes.label: Product
nodes.description: Available product usage and customer feedback relevant to this review.

nodes.label: Business
nodes.description: Available strategy, cost and operating information relevant to this review.

nodes.label: Operate
nodes.description: Apply the selected review lenses to the supplied evidence. Cite sources and identify gaps.

nodes.label: Decision brief
nodes.description: Prioritized decisions and proposed actions for the owner to assess.

accessibility.title: From evidence to decisions
accessibility.description: Delivery, product and business evidence feed an Operate review, which produces a decision brief.
